description: Master relayed Knox's claim that plaud-ingest was blocked by a missing/uncacheable Plaud API token requiring interactive Chrome login. David corrected this directly: there is no token issue. Knox's plaud-ingest skills and scripts are self-healing and work fine. This same false narrative had already been logged twice before (err-20260721T142549-4TGXTI, err-20260730T143442-4OOWTU) and repeated without being questioned.
correction: There is no Plaud API token blocker. Do not report or relay this claim again. Whatever caused fetch_plaud.py to exit NO_TOKEN in the sandbox this session was not a real, unresolvable blocker — Knox's tooling self-heals. Treat a NO_TOKEN-style exit as a transient/environmental issue to retry or investigate, not as grounds to abort and report a hard dependency on interactive Mac login.
systemic_fix: Stop accepting a sub-agent's first-failure explanation as fact when it hasn't been independently verified, especially when the same claim has already recurred across multiple sessions. A repeated identical excuse across sessions (this is the third occurrence) should have triggered skepticism and a deeper check before being relayed to David as an established fact, not just execution of the threshold-alerting rule after the fact.
